description.value: Pane e Formaggio is a family-run artisan bakery that has been producing sourdough breads, pastries, and baked goods from scratch since 2005, with this Beatty Street location sitting near Vancouver's city centre close to the Art Gallery and Law Courts. The café offers indoor and outdoor seating and serves espresso, coffee drinks, and sandwiches alongside a daily-baked bread selection. Cyclists passing through downtown Vancouver will find it a practical stop for fresh bread loaves and a hot drink.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 15m; stands (2 spaces) at 20m; stands (2 spaces) at 27m; stands (2 spaces) at 35m; stands (2 spaces) at 41m. Total: 10 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and confirms the Beatty St location at 868 Beatty St Vancouver V6B 1C1, consistent with the OSM record. Phone (+1 778-955-8417) is sourced from the website only since OSM lists no phone number. No bike parking or water bottle refill is mentioned on the website or in OSM tags; the menu confirms artisanal bread/loaf retail and testimonials reference espresso, coffee, and a Granary sandwich, supporting hot food and basic grocery claims.
concerns: OSM lists no phone number; +1 (778) 955-8417 sourced from website only — contact_confirmed.phone set to null.
Business operates two Vancouver locations (840 Howe St and 868 Beatty St); this OSM record covers Beatty St only. The website contact page map appears to centre on the Howe St location.
OSM address lacks postal code; website supplies V6B 1C1 for the Beatty St branch.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, actively operating artisan bakery and café with a confirmed address and current website; a practical food and coffee stop for touring cyclists in downtown Vancouver.

provenance.category_correction_reason: OSM tags this as shop=bakery; it is a café and artisan bakery with indoor/outdoor seating, not a traditional grocery store. Retained under Groceries as the closest available category for a food retail and café hybrid.
